expect_red: hovering any part of a rail lights that whole connected line -- its span, the curve that opened it, the curve that leaves it and every mark on it -- and nothing on another column

mutations.contract: A branch curve belongs to the leg it OPENS, not to the leg it forks out of. That is what lets a reader follow one line across a fork instead of losing it there.
mutations.note: Resolving the branch by its FROM column is the plausible wrong answer -- it is the column the curve starts on, and it type-checks -- so it is the one worth a witness. The guard sees it from both sides at once: the branch leg loses both curves and the mainline gains one.
